about: Game animation library for the VRoid characters. Kimodo entries (with a prompt) are generated on the DGX Spark by living/tools/kimodo/spark.sh and made game-ready by animate.py --library; keyed entries are animate.py's hand-keyed CLIPS. See the header of animate.py for every field. layer: upper plays the clip on the spine, arms and head only while the body moves, over its gait (the game's anim.rs); without it, or standing, the whole body plays it.

No take of 64 (5 prompts, 4 and 6 s) hopped three times within the floor limit; s34 (two hops, 1.3 cm) is the floor-safe alternative

Clip lab 2026-11-11, after dev-box asked for a more upright seat: torso -1.2 degrees from vertical (standing: -2; the old seat s0: +8.7 hunched, head 27.5 down), head 13.6, ankles 7.1 cm up, hands on the knees

Clip lab 2026-11-11: s100 sits down with the hands never on the floor (the old s0: fingers 8.9 cm under it), feet slide 3.9 cm/s p90; fails one check: toe tips 2.5 cm under the floor (limit 2.0), the least of 40 takes into this seat

Clip lab 2026-11-11, after dev-box asked for a live, upright seat: 8 s; a hand or the head moves 65 % of the time, never still, the head turns 41 degrees, the shoulders move 16 cm, torso +1.9 degrees from vertical (the old s0: 11 %, still 4.4 s, 1 degree, 0.6 cm, hunched +8.7, head 27.5 down). Fails one check: the ankles dip to 4.3 cm (the seat: 7.1) as the legs shift; every one of 104 takes did, by 3-5 cm

Clip lab 2026-11-11: from the upright seat dev-box asked for, s109 rocks forward onto the feet and stands; palms at most 0.9 cm under the floor, slide 5.2 cm/s p90, drift 2.1 cm (the old s0: knuckles 3.4 cm under, 9.0 cm/s, 7.3 cm); Kimodo's relaxed fingertips touch 6.8 cm through the floor, for the retarget to bend

clips.name: dodge
clips.prompt: a person dodges with a quick low dash forward, then recovers to standing
clips.note: combat: the rules dash 2.6 m at 5.2 m/s (dodge_dist, dodge_speed); the hips follow that track (2.72 SOMA m is 2.6 game m at k_game 0.956), and travel: path takes exactly it out (planted feet pinned along it), so the body's own motion carries the dash

clips.name: death
clips.prompt: a person is struck, collapses where they stand and falls to the ground, dead
clips.note: the hips stay over the origin (path), so the body falls where it stands. Laptop verdict 2026-11-12: s0 snapped in the raw take (left hand 128.5 degrees in one frame at f53, left thigh and foot 46-50 at f60; plant:false, so nothing downstream removes it). s1: the clip lab's first of the six (fails floor_feet 4.2 cm and floor_body 5.7 cm, as every take fails the floor); it collapses from 1.3 s and ends lying flat (hips 19 cm), largest one-frame joint step 27.0 degrees (right thigh and shin, f75-76), pop 1.33 m/s (s0 6.65). The laptop baked s1 and s4 on three rigs with leg-pole-1: s4 (largest step 7.8 degrees) ends over folded knees with the hips 37 cm up and reads as kneeling; s1 reads as dead, and its torso sinks 4-7 cm until the bake's torso guard (body-guard-1)
